parrafo_1.es: Barba's Painting & Services es el negocio de pintura de Danny en Hialeah. Su equipo se encarga de paredes interiores, repintados exteriores, reparación de drywall, muebles empotrados y lavado a presión, todo desde una sola línea directa.
parrafo_1.en: Barba's Painting & Services is Danny's painting business in Hialeah. His crew handles interior walls, exterior repaints, drywall repair, built-ins and pressure washing, all from a single direct line.

parrafo_2.es: Las reseñas repiten lo mismo: un equipo confiable y minucioso, trabajo terminado a tiempo y el lugar impecable al final. La biblioteca empotrada de Tai y la cerca y fachada de Mara son dos trabajos de los que sus clientes no dejan de hablar.
parrafo_2.en: Reviewers keep mentioning the same things: a reliable, detail-oriented crew, work finished on time, and a clean site left behind. Tai's built-in library and Mara's fence and exterior repaint are two jobs clients could not stop talking about.

items.quote: Highly recommend! They did an incredible job painting my backyard fence and the outside of my house. The work was clean, professional, and finished on time. You can tell they really care about the quality of their work. My house looks brand new! I will definitely be using them again for future projects.

If you're looking for quality work, go with Barbs Painting. Danny did an incredible job and ensured everything was done right from the first day to the last. My house looks amazing, and I'm beyond happy with the results. Great experience all around!

Danny's team was very reliable, friendly & efficient. They painted room we turned into a library and had built in bookshelves. They did a wonderful job! They also painted our rail. We are really happy with their service!
